# Interaction & UX Checklist: Issues — creation, detail and editing

**Purpose**: Validate that the interaction, editing, validation, rendering and accessibility requirements in `spec.md` are complete, unambiguous and objectively verifiable, before the feature is decomposed into tasks
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/screens.md](../contracts/screens.md) · [contracts/markdown.md](../contracts/markdown.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

This is a **requirements-quality** review, not a verification pass. Every item asks whether something is *written well*, not whether code *works*.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are loading-state requirements defined for either screen, given that both are served by queries and R2 fixes a skeleton convention this feature never invokes? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for how an issue with no description renders, distinct from one whose description is empty markdown? [Gap, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the save keystroke specified for keyboards without a Command key, or is ⌘-enter stated as the only accelerator deliberately? [Gap, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for submitting the create form without ever blurring the required field, given that validation is specified as per-field and on blur? [Gap, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK005 Are focus-management requirements defined for what receives focus after an in-place edit saves, reverts, or is refused? [Gap, Spec §FR-048, §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified what value the copy-link control places on the clipboard — the full address, the key, or something else? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for whether a successful write produces any confirmation at all, given that §4 defines a success toast kind and no requirement here calls for one? [Gap, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the concrete markdown tokens specified anywhere in the requirements, given that roadmap §1.1 assigned the subset's design to this child spec and the spec names constructs without naming their syntax? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, Roadmap §1.1]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for pasting multi-line content into the single-line title field? [Gap, Spec §FR-049]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 Is "a message naming what failed and why" reconciled with §4's toast convention — is the channel specified, or may an implementer choose inline text? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-050, §4]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "grows with its content" quantified with a bound, or is unbounded growth intended? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-031, §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK012 Can "the page MUST render identically for every user in structure" be objectively evaluated, and is "structure" defined? [Measurability, Spec §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "the key MUST be the page's first element" stated in terms a reviewer can apply — first in reading order, in the DOM, or in the visual layout? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the confirmation's required sentence specified precisely enough that two implementers would produce the same wording, or only its required content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-062]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "in-flight state" defined for the Create control beyond the control not being idle? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Are the two write surfaces' validation requirements consistent — does the create form and the issue page refuse an over-length value in the same terms? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037, §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the description requirements consistent between the create form and the issue page, including the absence of a preview and a toolbar on both? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK018 Do the optimistic-write requirements agree about which writes are optimistic and which wait, with creation and in-place editing on opposite sides consistently? [Consistency, Spec §FR-038, §FR-050, §FR-051]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the disabled-state requirements for the title and description consistent with those for the rail's controls, in wording as well as in effect? [Consistency, Spec §FR-051, §FR-054]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Is "in under one minute and with no step outside the create form" accompanied by a stated measurement method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK021 Is "visible within one interaction" defined well enough to distinguish a conforming implementation from one that waits for the server? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Does the markdown criterion enumerate the constructs it counts, so that "exactly the seven supported constructs" is checkable against a list? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK023 Is there a measurable criterion covering the rail's four controls as a set, or only criteria covering individual behaviours? [Coverage, Spec §SC-006, §SC-012]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are accessibility requirements defined for associating each disabled control's inline reason with the control programmatically, rather than only placing it nearby? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK025 Are keyboard requirements defined for the in-place editing gesture — how a keyboard-only user enters edit mode on a value that is described as clicked? [Gap, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements stated that no state on these screens is conveyed by colour alone, given that column and priority both carry colour? [Gap, Spec §FR-051]
- [ ] CHK027 Are any performance or responsiveness targets stated for either screen, or is their absence deliberate? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for the confirmation dialog's focus behaviour — trap, initial focus and dismissal — rather than only that it confirms once? [Gap, Spec §FR-061]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for a description whose markdown is malformed — an unclosed emphasis run, an unterminated link — rather than only for unsupported constructs? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for what the rail shows when the assignee pool is empty, or the project has exactly one column? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-022, §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the edge cases the spec lists for editing traced to a functional requirement each, or do some appear only as edge-case bullets? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK008 is the item worth reading first. The roadmap left the markdown subset's design "to R6's child spec", the spec named the constructs without their syntax, and [contracts/markdown.md](../contracts/markdown.md) settled the tokens at planning. Decide deliberately whether that is the right home for it
